decisions.reason: As a relatively low-investment, less publicly committed app adjacent to rather than central within the firm's core security offer, it is the easiest product to discontinue once weak traction can no longer be blamed only on temporary aviation conditions.

This named passenger-processing product line with several models reflects higher sunk investment and visible public commitment, so management is likely to continue it and justify disappointing results as temporary while it fits the firm's innovation-led airport strategy.

The self-service airline check-in solution appears strategically close to the firm's integrated airport offering and likely required meaningful development effort, making management inclined to persist despite uncertainty and treat any underperformance as temporary.
